subject: general
question: 'In The Afternoon of Time’ is an autobiographical book by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Rai Bachchan**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harivansh Rai Bachchan** was a noted **Indian poet of the Nayi Kavita literary movement (romantic upsurge) **of early 20th century Hindi literature.
 
• The book** 'In The Afternoon of Time' is his autobiography that captures his life, times, and the philosophy** that guided him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satyajit Ray:**

 
 
• **Satyajit Ray **is known globally for his **contributions to cinema.**
 
• He was awarded an **honorary Oscar in 1992** for his contributions to the film industry.
 
 
 
• **Sam Pitroda:**
 
 
• **Sam Pitroda,** formally known as **Satyanarayan Gangaram Pitroda, is a telecom engineer, inventor, entrepreneur, and policymaker.**
 
• In the **1980s**, he served as an advisor to Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and played a key role in **India's telecommunications revolution.**
 
 
 
• **PT Usha: **
 
 
• **Pilavullakandi Thekkeparambil Usha,** commonly known as **PT Usha**, is an Indian retired track and field athlete.
 
• She has been associated with Indian athletics since 1979.
 
• She is often called the** "queen of Indian track and field" **and is considered one of the greatest athletes India has ever produced.
